# Import libaries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

# Read data
```{r}
wego <- read_csv("../data/Route 50 Timepoint and Headway Data, 1-1-2023 through 5-12-2025.csv")

# Display head
wego |> 
  slice_head(n = 5)
```

# Create TSP_STATUS column
```{r}
wego <- wego |> 
  mutate(TSP_STATUS = 0, .before = CALENDAR_ID)

# Display head
wego |> 
  slice_head(n = 1)
```

```{r}
# Convert timestamp columns
wego <- wego |> 
  mutate(SCHEDULED_HMS = hms::as_hms(str_extract(as.character(SCHEDULED_TIME), "\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}")), .after = SCHEDULED_TIME) |> 
  mutate(ACTUAL_ARRIVAL_HMS = hms::as_hms(str_extract(as.character(ACTUAL_ARRIVAL_TIME), "\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}")), .after = ACTUAL_ARRIVAL_TIME) |> 
  mutate(ACTUAL_DEPARTURE_HMS = hms::as_hms(str_extract(as.character(ACTUAL_DEPARTURE_TIME), "\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}")), .after = ACTUAL_DEPARTURE_TIME)

# Display head
wego |> 
  slice_head(n = 1)
```
